decision.rationale: Discard under the supplied eligibility rule: audited seed-42 mean HR@10 is 0.591 for the candidate versus 0.59475 for the incumbent, below the proposed 0.59975 target; eligible_for_confirmation is false. The candidate exceeds the rotated control (0.58225) by 0.00875, but that descriptive contrast does not establish coordinate alignment. Candidate effects versus the incumbent are +0.013 for Movies_and_TV, +0.009 for Industrial_and_Scientific, -0.033 for Electronics, and -0.004 for CDs_and_Vinyl. The Industrial_and_Scientific candidate–control contrast is null. Audited receipts report fresh initialization and the frozen development protocol for the candidate and generated control; source admission and synthetic checks support bounded implementation validity, not a causal mechanism. No confirmation result is supplied.
unresolved_explanations: The incumbent convolution path may already preserve useful current-item information; the proposed deficit was not measured directly.
Representation scale, optimization, interaction of rotated coordinates with trained features, initialization, or checkpoint selection could explain the candidate–control difference.

An archived fixed-tensor cross-arm test of exact rotation and equal per-position signal norms was not supplied. The implementation author reported no synthetic checks; host admission and finite synthetic probes do not establish causal isolation.

The proposed internally padded and singleton-history checks and post-update scoring equality are not fully documented by the supplied evidence. Executed tensor paths and pre/post training contracts have finite-input scope.
Single-seed public development and exploratory history-length slices do not establish replication, a history-length benefit, or confirmation performance.
